title: Structured design-rule diagnostics
summary: Made backend validation results navigable through reusable hierarchical UI tooling.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2024-05-20. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Replaced flat/paged DRC result presentation with expandable rule and issue trees showing descriptions, severity, affected components and matching engine logs.
Created a reusable Angular Material/CDK diagnostic tree and integrated typed DRC categories and RxJS lifecycle teardown across status-bar and report flows.
Work covers diagnostic presentation and application integration; it does not establish authorship of the underlying design-rule library or a measured debugging-time reduction.

notes: 2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
